Found it in the corpus (pinned commit): `leveldb/util/env_posix.cc:59` — `constexpr const size_t kWritableFileBufferSize = 65536;` (identical at `util/env_windows.cc:40`). The constant is used in `PosixWritableFile::Append` (`env_posix.cc:293`) as the size of the per-file write buffer, `char buf_[kWritableFileBufferSize]`.

Note the current source writes the value literally as `65536` (an earlier revision expressed it as `64 * 1024`).

ANSWER: 65536
